name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-legend-furious-battle-rs3-arrangement
title: Final Fantasy Legend - Furious Battle (RS3 arrangement)
description:
A Romancing SaGa 3 / Kenji Ito styled arrangement (... or an attempt) of the final boss song from Final Fantasy Legend. Also known as Creator Battle, or Megadmin Battle if you played SMWCP. :b

Note: This port uses heavy samples, as such, it's incompatible with the following sound effects and jingles:

- Thunder and Blargg
- Yoshi
- Stage Clear (regular; Boss Clear isn't affected)
- Bonus End
